site.tagline: Lebanese Arabic, taught the way it's actually spoken.

hero.eyebrow: Lebanese Arabic, taught by a native speaker
hero.titleBefore: Speak Lebanese like you grew up on the block —
hero.body: Real lessons for expats, heritage speakers, and anyone falling for Lebanon — built for people who don't read Arabic yet. No classroom Arabic. Just how people actually talk.

about.title: Born in Beirut. Teaching the Lebanon you won't find in a textbook.
about.p1: I grew up hearing five conversations at once around the same table — that's the Lebanese I teach. Whether you're calling your teta every Sunday, marrying into a Lebanese family, or finally booking that trip to Beirut, I'll get you talking, fast.
about.p2: Every lesson comes from real life: airport small talk, ordering man2ushe, arguing about who pays the bill.
about.portraitAlt: Photo of the teacher — coming soon
about.t1Quote: Placeholder testimonial — I called my grandmother and held a whole conversation for the first time in my life.
about.t2Quote: Placeholder testimonial — six weeks in and I ordered my own coffee in Beirut without switching to English.
about.t3Quote: Placeholder testimonial — every other course taught me Arabic nobody actually speaks. This one didn't.

learn.title: Lessons that meet you where you are
learn.subtitle: Every word comes with audio, Arabic script, and Latin transliteration — so you can start speaking before you can read.
learn.pageSubtitle: A 12-unit survival course in Lebanese Arabic. Tap a unit to open the dialogue, the vocabulary, and the practice tasks.
learn.comingSoon: More units are on the way
learn.comingSoonBody: Units 4–12 cover directions, shopping, texting, future plans, opinions, and a final "survive a day in Lebanon" review.

games.title: Learn by playing, not memorizing
games.subtitle: Short, addictive games after every lesson — built to keep the dialect sticking.
games.pageSubtitle: Four games, all built from the same phrase bank as the lessons. Your progress is saved on this device.
games.listenBlurb: Hear it, pick what it means
